background.description: Sandy beige schoolyard ground with soft shadows of trees; below the last text line it is plain sand with a faint speckled pattern
background.rebuild_notes: Sand colour about #F2D9A6 with lighter and darker speckles and soft blurred shadow patches on the upper half. The upper part of the page is a blue sky with white clouds (not saved as a crop; see doubts). Crop bg.png is only the text-free sand strip below the last text line.

images.description: Bangladesh national flag: dark green rectangle with a red circle, waving on a tall silver flagpole with a round ball finial at the top
images.purpose: Shows the flag that the page title and poem are about
images.style: photo-like digital painting, soft shading, no outline, slight fold shadows on the flag
images.rebuild_notes: Flag is about 2:3 with the red disc slightly left of centre; flag edge is wavy. Pole is a thin silver shaft with a ball on top. Pole shaft below the flag (down to the base) is inside the building scene and is not part of this crop.

images.description: Left half of a one-storey school building: cream walls, pink roof edge, cream columns, a blue-framed window with grey grid bars, an open blue door showing a classroom with a green blackboard, students in white shirts and blue skirts at desks, potted plants, concrete steps, and a tree at the top
images.purpose: Shows the school in the scene
images.style: photo-like digital painting, soft light, no outline
images.rebuild_notes: Building is one storey with a flat pink-edged roof. Pillars are cream. Blue wood doors and window frames. Chalkboard on the classroom wall has tiny chalk writing and a small map drawing; it is too small to redraw as text. The classroom door at the centre-right of this crop is open. The flagpole base and the flower bed in front are not in this crop (see i4). The tree at the top of this crop is part of the sky scene.

images.description: Right half of the school building: a blue-framed window with a classroom behind it, a green blackboard and a wall map poster, an open blue door with students at desks, potted plants, and the cream end wall with its pink roof edge
images.purpose: Shows the school in the scene
images.style: photo-like digital painting, soft light, no outline
images.rebuild_notes: Same style as i2. Blue door at the right of the building is open. A map poster hangs on the cream wall to the left of the door. The flagpole passes in front of the building left edge of this crop; the pole itself is not in this crop.

images.description: Round pale stone base ring around the flagpole with a flower bed of green and red-orange plants in front of the building steps
images.purpose: Frames the base of the flagpole
images.rebuild_notes: Only the bottom strip of the base ring and flower bed. The top of the flower bed is in i2 and i3. The flagpole base (grey square plinth) is at the centre of this crop.

images.description: Leafy green tree branches at the top-left edge of the page, cut off by the page edge
images.purpose: Frames the top-left corner of the scene
images.rebuild_notes: Tree is cut by the left page edge. Light blue sky behind it.

images.description: Right-hand trees and garden: large leafy trees, a palm tree in the distance, a small pink-roofed house on the hill, a cream boundary wall and green shrubs in front of it
images.purpose: Frames the right side of the scene
images.rebuild_notes: Trees cut by the right page edge. The cream boundary wall starts at the right end of the school building (i3 ends at x 2021). Shrubs in front of the wall are green with small orange flowers.

doubts: Sky with clouds at the top of the page is not saved as a crop: it is behind the title and would need a crop that avoids the title text. The background crop is therefore sand only; the sky is described here but not saved as a file.
The flagpole shaft between the flag bottom (y 941) and the base is not in any crop (it runs between i2 and i3, x 1351 to 1374). It is part of the scene and may show as leftover ink.
Tree and bush areas between the building crops and the side trees (i5, i6) are split on the box edges; a few leaves may fall in the gap between crops.
Boxes were judged by eye from the displayed image (scale x1.64); edges may be off by a few pixels.
Chalk writing on the classroom blackboard and the wall map are too small to read and are not separate pictures.
